instruction: Build exactly one open rectangular curved panel as a single Brep face in millimeters. In its local coordinates, 0 <= x <= 100 and 0 <= y <= 80, the surface is z = 16 * (-15) * (x/100) * (1-x/100) * (y/80) * (1-y/80). All four edges have local z=0; the center has local z=-15. Rotate this local shape -30 degrees about the world X axis through the origin, then translate by [-60, 80, 45]. These define the final world coordinates, not a rotation about the shape center. Leave no other objects. The rectangular boundary must have no holes. Use the available RhinoMCP tools. Surface deviation may be up to 0.5 mm; local bounds and rectangular boundary must match within 0.001 mm. Topology and prescribed pose remain required.
